count_decision.note: Root and the independent reviewer verified the actual sum of both worker ETA passes, including construction of the first input snapshot. The four normal cases improve by 19.78 to 23.30 percent with unchanged full output and full precision costs; five or six of six pairs improve in each case. This supports only R2901 for internal ETA work. Whole pipeline times remain mixed, changed-delay fallback costs about 1.060 ms more, and the separate late helper uses 122743 more traced peak bytes. Both image changes complete existing contracts and add no IDs; the rejected initial experiment and all controls remain preserved.

native_validation.scope: Real native Tk widgets, timers, PhotoImage/QR, local HTTP bind, worker/Stop/Close/reopen event delivery on Linux. Each method uses its own interpreter. Only the older Mobile18 class display gate is enabled for these portable Tk cases; no sys.platform replacement and no repository skip changes. Windows and packaged behavior require exact-commit CI.

identical_before_after_source_map.note: Both native maps equal the final root map; image-replay scope is separately recorded.

accuracy_inputs.scope: Exact normalized RGB input borrowing, public owned normalizer, retained Stop/error cleanup and whole-module public metric/heatmap parity.

portrait_preparation_and_caller.scope: Borrowed oriented RGBA, required EXIF/mode conversion, unchanged composite/L/resize ordering, PixelAccess cleanup and caller-owned gray across real time-fitting.

preview_worker_cost_handoff.scope: Final bounded typed seal, exact cost breakdown, fresh late fields/calibration, owner/thread lifetime, changed-input fallback and complete historical method. Confirmed by explicit finalizer flag.

count_decision.note: Root and the independent reviewer verified the actual sum of both worker ETA passes, including construction of the first input snapshot. The four normal cases improve by 19.78 to 23.30 percent with unchanged full output and full precision costs; five or six of six pairs improve in each case. This supports only R2901 for internal ETA work. Whole pipeline times remain mixed, changed-delay fallback costs about 1.060 ms more, and the separate late helper uses 122743 more traced peak bytes. Both image changes complete existing contracts and add no IDs; the rejected initial experiment and all controls remain preserved.
count_decision.scope: At most one R2901; the two existing image contracts, tests, diagnostics and benchmark maintenance add zero IDs.

raw_provenance.scope: Final independent raw medians/work/allocations, negative evidence and lossless completion expansion.

final_metadata.scope: Independent review of the generated count, preserved prefix, source binding, actual gates, complete evidence expansion and bounded claims is closed without blockers.

import_boundary.method: Read-only source-graph audit of the explicit image replay entrypoints and all other current root Python files; the changed module name has no reference in that set. Both replays call their explicit historical/current graphs and do not discover or execute benchmark files. This is not a captured runtime-import trace.

image_replays.manifest_serialization: json.dumps(map, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False); UTF-8

source_binding.note: Original image-replay maps are preserved. Only an explicitly listed non-executed standalone benchmark change may differ; otherwise a real replay is required.

completion_evidence.note: Exact parsed JSON via lossless manifest references; original text/PNG bytes, initial harness diagnostics and all checkpoints are preserved.

eta_comparison.method: One observed parity pair, one unobserved warm parity pair, 6 balanced AB/BA pairs per workload; separate live-result tracemalloc probes. Timed pipeline calls also wrap and delegate both real estimate_from_plan passes, recording each elapsed interval and their sum. The first pass includes creation of the local input seal. Wrapper setup is outside the complete pipeline timer; both sides have identical instrumentation. No extra timers run during observed, warm, standalone, allocation or verify-only ETA passes.
eta_comparison.scope: Complete historical DrawBot and DrawTimeEstimate, with identical current other dependencies. Pipeline is real update_plan/worker/make_plan/queue/poll/Tcl labels. Standalone is real public make_plan; late-estimate is the actual late estimator with its plan and possible private observation prepared before measurement. Setup, source construction, calibration directory routing, normalization, hashing and cleanup are outside intervals. RAM OS probe is fixed to8192MB on both sides; product clocks/watchdogs remain real. No native widget painting, physical mouse, Windows, GPU, RSS or general speed claim.
label_exclusions: Existing planning elapsed text and profiler suffix only.

seal_only.method: Four balanced AB/BA pairs,20 actual signature calls per side; per-call elapsed. Separate single-call tracemalloc with result alive. Model/sequence captured from the real dense pipeline/fresh estimator. This compares the rejected tuple representation to the compact byte representation only.

intermediate_compact_eta_experiment.scope: Separate four-pair pipeline/late comparison and four-pair signature-only comparison with twenty calls per sample. No whole-application gain is inferred from the signature-only or late-only interval.

steps.name: Run exact raster and portable planner regressions
Run Image Draw Bot Windows self-test
Build and validate the Windows bundle
Verify packaged GUI and native drag and drop

prior_checkpoint_validation.scope: Root independently fetched the exact bfa43deb check rows, all14 Windows job steps and full Windows log. The seven completed success checks include Linux core, both dependency jobs and all CodeQL analysis/aggregate checks. Detailed Linux counts are kept separately in the agent-fetched report. These are parent checkpoint results for batch29, not certification of later uncommitted source. No release was published.

uncounted_completions: CP06/CG29/IW08: read already normalized matching RGB source/preview inputs without identity copies; preserve owned normalization, metrics, alpha/keyed modes and cleanup.
R1502/DP42/IW08: borrow already oriented RGBA in actual Portrait preparation; preserve required transformations and close private gray/PixelAccess on Stop or errors.
Tests, source-binding audits, initial diagnostics, rejected experiments, packaging and metadata add no IDs.
remote_validation: New-head Windows/Linux, dependency, CodeQL and packaged GUI/native-drop checks must be recorded separately after publication. Parent CI and local platform skips do not certify the new Windows package.
